final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS avg_rental_count, AVG(rc.rental_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE rc.rental_count > o.avg_count
